say:3:1222556001:0.text: This place is relatively open and has a good vantage point. It seems like a great spot to lure Harak!
say:3:1222556001:0.source_cn: 这地方相对空旷，视野也好。感觉是诱哈拉克上钩的好地方！

say:4:1222556002:0.text: Excellent, it's time for me to take the stage.
say:4:1222556002:0.source_cn: 很好很好，这时候就轮到我登场了。

say:5:1222556003:0.text: Alright, brave heroes! Who will step forward to reveal their true selves?
say:5:1222556003:0.source_cn: 好了，勇敢的英雄们！展出的舞台已经备好，谁身先士卒展现...

say:6:1222556004:0.text: Chippy has nothing to hide! Chippy will go first!
say:6:1222556004:0.source_cn: 满满，让满满来吧，满满没什么要隐瞒的！

say:7:1222556005:0.text: I'm ready too. To defeat Harak, I'm willing to bare my heart.
say:7:1222556005:0.source_cn: 我也是。为了击败哈拉克，我愿意展示心中的愿望。

say:8:1222556006:1.text: Well then, close your eyes, and I'll cast my fairy magic.
say:8:1222556006:1.source_cn: 那——么，闭上眼睛，让我来施展妖精的魔法吧！

cinematic_dialogue:12:1222557001:.text: Hamsters of the Heroic Order, fall in line!

say:16:1222556007:0.text: Wow, I've never seen so many hamsters in all my life.
say:16:1222556007:0.source_cn: 哇哦，我这辈子还没见过这么多仓鼠呢。

say:17:1222556008:0.text: That's Chippy, the leader of the Heroic Order! Chippy is training new recruits!
say:17:1222556008:0.source_cn: ——那是仓鼠骑士团团长满满！我在训练指挥新人！

say:20:1222556009:0.text: I'm casting spells, and they're all spells I've created myself!
say:20:1222556009:0.source_cn: 我在用魔法……而且是原创的魔法！

say:21:1222556010:0.text: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...
say:21:1222556010:0.male: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...
say:21:1222556010:0.female: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...

say:22:1222556011:0.text: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.
say:22:1222556011:0.source_cn: 一个想要成为名副其实的杰出骑士，另一个想要成长为能和梅...
say:22:1222556011:0.male: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.
say:22:1222556011:0.female: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.

say:24:1222556013:0.text: They aren't overly grand or spectacular wishes, but two very lovely dreams!
say:24:1222556013:0.source_cn: 不是宏大的愿望，也没有瑰丽奇炫的场面，但却是两个很小很...

say:27:1222556014:0.text: Be careful not to twitch your little noses. I've scattered hypnotic fairy dust around, a special gift for Harak. It's not for you.
say:27:1222556014:0.source_cn: 小心哟，别在这时候抽动你们的小鼻子。我在周围洒下了能够...

say:28:1222556015:0.text: With such wonderful dreams, that greedy Hyposhark will surely take the bait!
say:28:1222556015:0.source_cn: 嘻嘻，面对这么活泼美好的愿景，那只贪吃的鲨鱼恶魔一定会上钩！

say:31:1222556016:1.text: Since we're at it, let's <style="highlight">set a few more traps</style>. We need to ensure Harak is truly hypnotized before <style="stress"><player_name></style> can seal him.
say:31:1222556016:1.male: Since we're at it, let's <style="highlight">set a few more traps</style>. We need to ensure Harak is truly hypnotized before <style="stress"><player_name></style> can seal him.
say:31:1222556016:1.female: Since we're at it, let's <style="highlight">set a few more traps</style>. We need to ensure Harak is truly hypnotized before <style="stress"><player_name></style> can seal him.

say:33:1222556018:1.text: Since the sword-wielding hero has spoken, let's keep going!
say:33:1222556018:1.source_cn: 既然持剑的英雄都发话了，那么接下来，前进——！

narration:35:12022082:0.text: Tasi reveals the wishes of Chippy and Hammie. Chippy aspires to be the captain of Heroic Order, while Hammie wishes to stay by your side forever as your familiar.
narration:35:12022082:0.source_cn: 塔西把满满和漫漫的心愿展示在了你们面前，原来满满梦想成...
